EDGE HUB - controller control center for Windows 10 / 11
==========================================================

WORKS WITH
  - PS4 controllers (DualShock 4 and PS4-style controllers like Hex Gaming)
  - PS5 DualSense and DualSense Edge
  - Xbox One / Series / 360 controllers, plus GameSir, 8BitDo, PowerA and other
    controllers in Xbox (X-input) mode
  USB or Bluetooth.

START
  1. Unzip and double-click EdgeHub.exe (no install needed).
     Windows may say "Windows protected your PC" because the app isn't from a
     big publisher: click "More info" -> "Run anyway".
  2. Plug in or pair your controller. It shows up on the Home page.
  3. To use your settings in games: Settings -> "Install driver" (one time,
     click Yes when Windows asks), then turn on "Remapping" at the top right.
     The tester, light bar, keyboard/mouse buttons and macros work without it.

WHAT IT DOES
  - Remap any button to an Xbox/PlayStation button, keyboard key, key combo
    (e.g. Win+Alt+G to save a clip), mouse click or media key
  - Turbo, toggle, a shift layer and macros (record them from your controller)
  - Stick dead zones, anti-dead zone, response curves (drag the graph),
    hi-res stick, anti-snapback, aim (L2) sensitivity, drift fix
  - Trigger dead zones, curves and hair trigger
  - Gyro aiming, stick-as-mouse, touchpad-as-trackpad
  - Light bar colours and effects, vibration strength
  - Profiles that switch automatically per game
  - Games see an Xbox or a PlayStation controller (your choice)

TIPS
  - If a game reacts twice to each press, it's seeing your real controller AND
    Edge Hub's virtual one: turn on Steam Input for that game, or use HidHide.
  - "Stick shake" only works in games you add to its single-player list.
  - To undo everything: Settings -> "Restore original setup".
  - Your settings are saved in %APPDATA%\EdgeHub.
